notes: DRAFT for Ethereum mainnet (chain 1); not submitted. TODO before import: TODO_MAINNET_STACKER = the imd/acc Stacker on mainnet; TODO_START = the unix time anyone may seed (the owner may seed earlier); $owner to be chosen. The code is Sepolia test run 3's (the accepted launch #1311 code plus letters and auto-sell, a 1% minimum plea, the owner excluded from seasons and keeper tips, a six-season PLEA bonus and the Cabal's judging rules v2). Deploy all seven contracts (PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, Laureates, PleaDistributor, Letterbox, PleaLaunch) in this order, with zero ETH, in one factory transaction; PleaLaunch's constructor registers the system contracts and then the Letterbox. IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 is both the oracle fee asset (0.5 IMD per plea, oracle.request@oracle-1) and the pool currency, so the Letterbox buys the oracle fee with the writer's PLEA together with the 0.25 IMD tip (mintOracleFee = false; the constructor refuses minting on chain 1). Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82: pleas are asked with requestWithFailure; onPleaFailure clears only our own still-pending plea and never moves value; expire() after 20 minutes stays as the fallback. Oracle signer 0x5598...2982. 15-day seasons (1296000 s), 33-hour dead-man (118800 s); the CabalGate constructor refuses less on chain 1. Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, credit gas 400000. PLEA.init mints 87% to the hook, 3% to Seasons and 10% to PleaDistributor; each of the first six seasons pays 5,000,000 PLEA to its qualifying top 10 and burns the unpaid rest. Fees, plea timings, panel 30 and quorum 17 are unchanged. Gas: the manifest rehearsal reports about 24.3M gas, over Ethereum's 16,777,216 per-transaction cap; whether IMD's mainnet deploy is bound by that cap is an open question. PleaHook is not a manifest entry: PleaLaunch commits to its init-code hash and deployHook(salt, initCode) deploys it with a salt mined for the hook flags; seed() opens trading.
